scope: Read-only public official documentation. S500 is a project label, not an assumed market symbol.
status: Documentation-qualified candidate; not procured, entitled, installed, or data-validated.

recommended_path.conditional_tier: Options Standard, published at $80/month for individuals, is the lowest documented tick tier if the intended use qualifies under the applicable personal/nonprofessional agreement. Otherwise obtain business terms and pricing. Value, published at $40/month, supplies one-minute snapshots if that granularity is acceptable.
recommended_path.quote_request: Use /v3/option/history/quote with interval=tick, the actual underlying root, and one historical date. Discover quoted contracts for each date with /v3/option/list/contracts/quote, then verify available dates using /v3/option/list/dates/quote.
recommended_path.transport: Python>=3.12 SDK with API-key support >=1.0.9 usesHTTPS auth/gRPC data without a terminal; REST docs require local v3 terminal+Java>=21. Neither transport tested.
recommended_path.coverage: Published tierhistory includes requested 2026 period in principle only. Verify actualtarget symbols/dates after entitlement; no data retrieved.

granularity.tick: Explicit interval=tick; default 1s. Standard/Pro tick entitlement.
